english.note: Use this for a formal or technical description of a phenomenon affecting the world as a whole.
Choose this when the emphasis is worldwide scope or something common to people everywhere rather than relations between particular nations.

examples.english: This study shows that climate change is a worldwide problem.
examples.traditional: 呢次調查顯示，氣候變化係一個全球性問題。
